title: Webster
description:
S5 E6 — George's Brush With Life
After learning that his buddies from school have died, George quits his job and resolves to live life to the hilt.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E7 — The Importance of Being Worthy
Webster and Nicky's excitement over a fund-raiser they organized fizzles when the proceeds are stolen.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E8 — A Hell of a Weekend
A weekend at Wisconsin Dells with parents of Webster's best friend reveals more than Katherine and George want to see, they are nudists.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E9 — Simple Gifts
Katherine's rich Uncle Charles visits for Christmas. George is worried Webster is forgetting the important part of the season.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E10 — Nerds Are People Too
When Webster decides to join the school's community service club, he finds that all of its members are nerds. But after giving back to a community of retirees, Webster discovers that nerds are people too.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E11 — The Cruise
George and Katherine recall how they met on a two-week Greek cruise, fell in love, and got married before it was over.

S3 E4 — The Sing-Off
In charge of the big choir competition, Mary must make room in her have for the visiting choir's deacon, who is notoriously arrogant, thoughtless and pushy.

S3 E5 — And Baby Makes Three
Alarmed by Brenda and her friends' casual attitude about teen pregnancy, Mary uses some unusual methods to teach them a lesson about parenting that they'll never forget.

S3 E6 — Men's Club
Mary is delighted to learn that Lester will be named 'Man of the Year' by the local Men's Club...and distraught upon discovering she's not allowed to attend the special ceremony.

S3 E7 — Low Noon
To protest the opening of a sleazy club in her neighborhood, Mary dreams of running the varmints out of town.

S3 E8 — Tangled Web
In an effort to help Lester build his business, Mary takes some questionable steps to land him a big construction contract.

S3 E9 — The Most Happy Marriage
Mary and Lester are shocked when his cousin Ed's enviable 'picture-perfect' marriage suddenly falls apart.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E20 — George And Jimmy
When George calls President Carter as a publicity stunt, he gets more publicity than he expected and the Jeffersons get a night they'll never forget.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E21 — Thomas H. Willis & Co
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E8 — Jealousy
Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E9 — Tooth Or Consequences
When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.
